summary: Match Group filed a Form 8-K on August 4, 2026, reporting Q2 2026 financial results via press release and prepared remarks, and declaring a quarterly cash dividend of $0.20 per share payable October 20, 2026 to holders of record October 5, 2026. No special-situations event is present; the filing is a routine results and dividend announcement. The dividend is a regular quarterly distribution, not an extraordinary capital return. The content focuses on operational performance, including Tinder engagement improvements and Hinge revenue growth. There are no acquisitions, divestitures, activist campaigns, strategic reviews, tender offers, going-private transactions, spin-offs, rights offerings, restructuring, liquidations, delistings, issuer tenders, deal terminations, SPAC activity, or forced management changes. This filing is a standard current report, so no special-situation classification applies.
